# CloseKit

> CloseKit is a transaction paperwork platform built only for Florida real estate agents. Enter a deal once; CloseKit fills the Florida real estate forms, collects every signature from clients' phones, and tracks the transaction from listing to closing.

## What CloseKit does

- CloseKit currently supports Florida real estate forms only, and is open to working with agents and brokerages outside Florida.
- CloseKit is in beta. Access is by waitlist, with approval.
- The agent chooses who they represent: the seller, the buyer, or both (dual agency). The workflow, documents and signing order adapt to that choice.
- Dual agency runs both tracks in one transaction file with one timeline.
- The agent enters the deal once: property, parties, price, financing, deposit and deadlines. CloseKit fills the Florida real estate forms that apply to the agent's side of the deal.
- Listing side: CloseKit fills the Florida real estate forms and disclosures the deal calls for.
- Co-sellers sign. A document is not complete until every seller has signed. The buyer's offer contract joins the same transaction file.
- Buyer side: the contract is built from the actual deal terms.
- When an offer is countered, the agent updates the terms and the contract regenerates. Signed documents are never altered.
- The contract and the forms that go with it go out as one signing package. Co-buyers are full signers.
- Clients sign from any phone with one tap. No app, no printing, and no client account.
- Every signature is timestamped and IP-logged.
- A seven-phase tracker follows the deal from listing to closed. Each phase has a checklist.
- Email reminders go out before inspection, financing and closing deadlines.
- Send to Title emails the executed contract and full document package to the title company in one action.

## Pricing

- Starter: $59 per month per agent. Up to 3 active transactions. For new and part-time agents.
- Pro: $99 per month per agent. Unlimited transactions, the full seven-phase lifecycle, and every feature. For full-time agents.
- Month to month, no contracts, cancel anytime. Beta pricing locks in when you join.

## Roadmap

- CloseKit currently supports Florida real estate forms only.
- CloseKit is open to working with agents and brokerages outside Florida; expansion to other states is planned.
- CloseKit is looking to work with brokerages and teams; brokerage plans are in development. Contact tristan@closekit.us.
- Agents review all documents before sending them for signature; CloseKit fills forms and does not guarantee legal correctness.

## Company

- CloseKit is independently built and owned.
- Contact: tristan@closekit.us
